item.title: Dolores Huerta opens up about Cesar Chavez abuse allegations: 'It was very hard to keep this'
item.description: Huerta is speaking on camera for the first time about her allegations against Cesar Chavez, describing decades of private pain.

item.title: Chicago Board of Education votes to revoke charter for ASPIRA Network schools
item.description: The Chicago Board of Education has voted unanimously to revoke the charter of the ASPIRA charter school network.

item.title: Metra to test new ticket process with riders scanning tickets before boarding
item.description: Metra is testing out new ticket checks at five downtown Chicago stations. Riders will need to have their Ventra or paper ticket scanned before boarding trains.

item.title: Some question if Chicago school should be renamed after César Chavez sex abuse allegations
item.description: Allegations of sexual abuse against civil rights and farm labor icon César Chavez are reverberating through Chicago's Latino community.

item.title: Home insurance drops and denial rates increasing more in Chicago area than national average
item.description: Data shows that non-renewal rates, for reasons other than non-payment, are now higher in our area, more than the national average. Non-renewals are also increasing nationwide.

item.title: Chinese American Service League honors former ABC7 anchor Linda Yu
item.description: Chinese American Service League honors former ABC7 anchor Linda Yu

item.title: Joliet City Council approves plans for what would be largest data center in Illinois
item.description: All but one Joliet City Council member voted yes on a 795-acre database center next to the Chicagoland Speedway.

item.title: Chicago Deputy Mayor for Public Safety Garien Gatewood suddenly fired, officials say
item.description: The man who oversaw public safety in the mayor's office is speaking out after being suddenly fired for reasons that are now raising questions as agencies begin turning their attention to summer and plans to prevent violence.

item.title: Missing suburban college student James Gracey found dead in waters off Barcelona beach: local police
item.description: Catalan police say Chicago-area native college student James Gracey has been found dead in waters off a Barcelona beach after he went missing during a spring break trip.

item.title: Loyola student killed in Rogers Park shooting near beach, Chicago police say; vigil held on campus
item.description: An 18-year-old woman was shot and killed while walking with friends near Loyola University in Rogers Park Thursday morning, Chicago police said. A vigil was held on campus as students mourn the loss.
